limitations: Event witnesses are not independent immediate native property observations.
Native validity alone does not establish site acceptance.
No full product, two-product, broad ATS, timing superiority, statistical superiority, or Gate A claim.
Four variants are related synthetic examples, not independent broad coverage.

Same required actual-extension-realm native observer on both systems covers only its frozen installed surfaces; retained references, other realms, main-world mutations and uninstalled APIs remain unobserved.

native_observer.integrity: Install exact unique runtime-id realm; snapshot integrity/sequence/surfaces before first synthetic write and after settle; refuse unavailable or failed integrity.
limits: Installed prototype surfaces in one actual extension realm only.
No retained pre-install native references, other realms, uninstalled APIs, main-world page mutations, closed roots or live employer forms are covered.
Both systems retain identical event meter/final snapshots, but runtime architecture/browser/origins may differ.

candidate_runtime_inventory_policy.non_source_limits: Installed third-party dependencies are bound by toolchain/package/lock files; actual extension bundle bytes require separate fresh-build provenance and start/end build inventories.
